ctx.x: Ms. Wallace, in November 1926, around -- in 1926, I see that they say here that there was a Cicero Thomas who played the coronet. And somebody else wrote underneath it that you never knew somebody by that name.
I wonder why they made a mistake like that and put a name down like Cicero Thomas for coronet in those tunes. It was "I'm a Mighty Tight Woman" and --
